subject: Next steps: technical deep dive + stakeholder intake
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Martinez <alice@technimbus.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps: technical deep dive + stakeholder intake

Hi Alice — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call so we keep momentum: 

1) Goal: run a 60–75 minute technical deep dive/demo focused on integration points (SSO, data residency, API limits) and a short performance/cost walkthrough for your platform team.
2) Attendees we should include: your platform lead + security and procurement (so we can clear SSO and contracting questions).
3) Requested pre-reads: a short list of pre-demo questions (attached) and any existing SSO docs you can share.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Nov 24, 10:00–11:15
- Wed Nov 25, 13:00–14:15

Agenda (45–60 min tech deep dive / 15 min procurement Q&A):
- 5 min intro & goals
- 20–30 min architecture, SSO, network/connectivity requirements (Dev)
- 15–20 min deployment options + perf/cost tradeoffs (Marissa / Diego)
- 15 min procurement/next-steps checklist (contracts/PO/timeline)

Can you confirm who from your side should be included (security/procurement contact emails) and which slot works best? I’ve copied Marissa (AE) and Dev (solutions eng) to coordinate. I’ve attached a short pre-demo questionnaire and a draft SOW for procurement to review — we can iterate after the call.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
d: +1 415-555-0123

From: Alice Martinez <alice@technimbus.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Liu <tom.liu@technimbus.com>, Karen Briggs <karen.b@technimbus.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 17:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: technical deep dive + stakeholder intake

Thanks Diego — really appreciated the call. Tom (security) and Karen (procurement) are copied. A couple notes from our side before we lock a time: 

- We prefer Nov 24 or Nov 26; Nov 25 conflicts with an internal offsite. If Nov 24, could we push to 11:00–12:15 PST instead? That gives Tom a small buffer.
- Security will want to see any SOC2/audit artifacts and an initial list of required network ports/VPC peering options — is that included in the "pre-demo questions" or a separate packet?
- Procurement would like a draft SOW and ballpark pricing before the deep dive if possible.

Tom — I’ve flagged the pre-demo doc Diego attached. Can you confirm the top security contact who should join (if different from yourself)?

Karen — procurement asks: lead time for a standard enterprise SOW and whether Redwood accepts Net30 + PO. Diego/Marissa — can you flag procurement terms?

Best,
Alice
VP, Platform Engineering | TechNimbus

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Martinez <alice@technimbus.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: technical deep dive + stakeholder intake

Hi Alice — thanks for the quick turnaround and for looping Tom/Karen. 

Nov 24 at 11:00–12:15 PST works for us. I’ve tentatively booked a slot on our side; will send a calendar invite once we confirm final attendees.

Quick answers to the procurement/security asks: 
- Security packet: Diego — I attached our standard Security_Packet.zip and the SOC2 attestation in the drive link. Hannah (cc’d) will lead the security portion on the call and can follow up if Tom wants deeper artifacts.
- Procurement terms: Rohan (cc’d) — we can support Net30 + PO for enterprise deals; SOW turnaround is typically 2 business days for the initial draft and we can iterate. The attached SOW_v1.pdf includes standard terms and an outline of deliverables/SLAs.

Dev — please prepare an architecture slide that shows SSO/SAML flow, expected egress IPs, and an option matrix for Dedicated vs Hosted with rough latency/cost bullets. Also please flag any items in the attached pre-demo questions you want TechNimbus to answer ahead of the call.

Alice — if you can share Tom’s preferred artifact format (PDF vs spreadsheet) or any internal intake form, Hannah will triage. Once we finalize attendees I’ll send the invite with the agenda and links to the SOW and security files.

Thanks — Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

2) Share any network ACLs or firewall rules that could block outbound 443 and the 10.0.0.x range if you plan private peering.
